name: CV_BS_IMP_COMP
xmlDefinition:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<Calculation:scenario xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:Calculation="http://www.sap.com/ndb/BiModelCalculation.ecore" schemaVersion="2.3" id="CV_BS_IMP_COMP" applyPrivilegeType="ANALYTIC_PRIVILEGE" checkAnalyticPrivileges="true" defaultClient="$$client$$" defaultLanguage="$$language$$" hierarchiesSQLEnabled="false" translationRelevant="true" visibility="reportingEnabled" calculationScenarioType="SCRIPT_BASED" dataCategory="CUBE" enforceSqlExecution="true" executionSemantic="UNDEFINED" scriptParametersCaseSensitive="true">
  <origin/>
  <descriptions defaultDescription="Bank Statement Importing Completion"/>
  <metadata changedAt="2015-08-10 16:12:30.933"/>
  <defaultSchema schemaName="SAP_ECC"/>
  <localVariables/>
  <variableMappings/>
  <dataSources/>
  <calculationViews>
    <calculationView xsi:type="Calculation:SqlScriptView" id="Script_View">
      <descriptions/>
      <viewAttributes>
        <viewAttribute datatype="NVARCHAR" id="MANDT" length="2"/>
        <viewAttribute datatype="NVARCHAR" id="BANKS" length="3"/>
        <viewAttribute datatype="NVARCHAR" id="BANKL" length="15"/>
        <viewAttribute datatype="NVARCHAR" id="ACC_ID" length="10"/>
        <viewAttribute datatype="NVARCHAR" id="AZDAT" length="8"/>
        <viewAttribute datatype="NUMERIC" id="COMP_STATUS" length="1"/>
        <viewAttribute datatype="NUMERIC" id="BK_AC_COUNT" length="10"/>
        <viewAttribute datatype="NUMERIC" id="BK_AC_COMP_COUNT" length="10"/>
      </viewAttributes>
      <calculatedViewAttributes/>
      <definition> 
 /********* Begin Procedure Script ************/ 
BEGIN 

    tmp_ac_comp = SELECT tmp_total_ac.mandt, tmp_total_ac.banks, tmp_total_ac.bankl, tmp_total_ac.acc_id,
                         tmp_bs_ac.azdat,
                         (CASE WHEN days_between(tmp_bs_ac.azdat, CURRENT_DATE) < tmp_bs_ac.moni_itvl_day
                               THEN 1
                               ELSE 0
                           END) comp_status
                     FROM (SELECT mandt, banks, bankl, acc_id
                             FROM fclm_bam_amd) tmp_total_ac
                          LEFT JOIN
                          (SELECT t_amd.mandt, t_amd.banks, t_amd.bankl, t_amd.acc_id,
                                  MAX(t_bs.azdat) azdat,
                                  MIN(IFNULL(t_bsm.exp_number * 
                                      MAP(t_bsm.exp_rhyth, 0, 30, 1, 1, 2, 7, 3, 15, 4, 365), 99999999)) moni_itvl_day
                             FROM febko t_bs JOIN fclm_bam_ac_link t_lk ON (t_bs.mandt = t_lk.mandt
                                          AND t_bs.hbkid = t_lk.hbkid
                                          AND t_bs.hktid = t_lk.hktid
                                          AND t_bs.bukrs = t_lk.bukrs)
                                  JOIN fclm_bam_amd t_amd ON (t_lk.mandt = t_amd.mandt
                                          AND t_lk.acc_id = t_amd.acc_id)
                                  LEFT JOIN tfte_bsm_cust t_bsm ON (t_bsm.mandt = t_bs.mandt
                                          AND t_bsm.bukrs = t_bs.bukrs
                                          AND t_bsm.hbkid = t_bs.hbkid
                                          AND t_bsm.hktid = t_bs.hktid)
                            GROUP BY t_amd.mandt, t_amd.banks, t_amd.bankl, t_amd.acc_id) tmp_bs_ac ON (tmp_total_ac.mandt = tmp_bs_ac.mandt
                                                       AND tmp_total_ac.banks = tmp_bs_ac.banks
                                                       AND tmp_total_ac.bankl = tmp_bs_ac.bankl
                                                       AND tmp_total_ac.acc_id = tmp_bs_ac.acc_id);
/*
    tmp_bank_comp = SELECT mandt, banks, bankl, COUNT(acc_id) bk_ac_count, 
                           SUM(comp_status) bk_ac_comp_count
                      FROM :tmp_ac_comp
                     GROUP BY mandt, banks, bankl;
*/                     
    var_out = SELECT t_ac.mandt, t_ac.banks, t_ac.bankl, t_ac.acc_id, t_ac.azdat,
                     t_ac.comp_status, 1 bk_ac_count, t_ac.comp_status bk_ac_comp_count
                FROM :tmp_ac_comp t_ac;
              /*
                 JOIN :tmp_bank_comp t_bk ON (t_ac.mandt = t_bk.mandt
                           AND t_ac.banks = t_bk.banks
                           AND t_ac.bankl = t_bk.bankl)
              */

END /********* End Procedure Script ************/</definition>
    </calculationView>
  </calculationViews>
  <logicalModel id="Script_View">
    <descriptions/>
    <attributes>
      <attribute id="MANDT" order="1">
        <descriptions defaultDescription="MANDT"/>
        <keyMapping columnObjectName="Script_View" columnName="MANDT"/>
      </attribute>
      <attribute id="BANKS" order="2">
        <descriptions defaultDescription="BANKS"/>
        <keyMapping columnObjectName="Script_View" columnName="BANKS"/>
      </attribute>
      <attribute id="BANKL" order="3">
        <descriptions defaultDescription="BANKL"/>
        <keyMapping columnObjectName="Script_View" columnName="BANKL"/>
      </attribute>
      <attribute id="ACC_ID" order="4">
        <descriptions defaultDescription="ACC_ID"/>
        <keyMapping columnObjectName="Script_View" columnName="ACC_ID"/>
      </attribute>
      <attribute id="AZDAT" order="5">
        <descriptions defaultDescription="AZDAT"/>
        <keyMapping columnObjectName="Script_View" columnName="AZDAT"/>
      </attribute>
      <attribute id="COMP_STATUS" order="6">
        <descriptions defaultDescription="COMP_STATUS"/>
        <keyMapping columnObjectName="Script_View" columnName="COMP_STATUS"/>
      </attribute>
    </attributes>
    <calculatedAttributes/>
    <privateDataFoundation>
      <tableProxies/>
      <joins/>
      <layout>
        <shapes/>
      </layout>
    </privateDataFoundation>
    <baseMeasures>
      <measure id="BK_AC_COUNT" order="7" aggregationType="sum" measureType="simple">
        <descriptions defaultDescription="BK_AC_COUNT"/>
        <measureMapping columnObjectName="Script_View" columnName="BK_AC_COUNT"/>
      </measure>
      <measure id="BK_AC_COMP_COUNT" order="8" aggregationType="sum" measureType="simple">
        <descriptions defaultDescription="BK_AC_COMP_COUNT"/>
        <measureMapping columnObjectName="Script_View" columnName="BK_AC_COMP_COUNT"/>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<Calculation:scenario xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:Calculation="http://www.sap.com/ndb/BiModelCalculation.ecore" schemaVersion="2.3" id="CV_EX_ITEM" applyPrivilegeType="ANALYTIC_PRIVILEGE" checkAnalyticPrivileges="true" defaultClient="$$client$$" defaultLanguage="$$language$$" hierarchiesSQLEnabled="false" translationRelevant="true" visibility="reportingEnabled" calculationScenarioType="SCRIPT_BASED" dataCategory="CUBE" enforceSqlExecution="true" executionSemantic="UNDEFINED" runWithInvokerPrivileges="true" scriptParametersCaseSensitive="true">
  <origin/>

  <metadata changedAt="2015-08-10 16:21:09.53"/>
  <defaultSchema schemaName="SAP_ECC"/>
  <localVariables/>
  <variableMappings/>
  <dataSources/>
  <calculationViews>
    <calculationView xsi:type="Calculation:SqlScriptView" id="Script_View">
      <descriptions/>
      <viewAttributes>
        <viewAttribute datatype="NVARCHAR" id="MANDT" length="3"/>
        <viewAttribute datatype="NVARCHAR" id="BANKS" length="3"/>
        <viewAttribute datatype="NVARCHAR" id="BANKL" length="15"/>
        <viewAttribute datatype="DECIMAL" id="ACC_ID" length="10" scale="0"/>
        <viewAttribute datatype="NVARCHAR" id="ACC_TYPE_ID" length="10"/>
        <viewAttribute datatype="NVARCHAR" id="TRANS_DATE" length="8"/>
        <viewAttribute datatype="NVARCHAR" id="BUKRS" length="4"/>
        <viewAttribute datatype="DECIMAL" id="GJAHR" length="4" scale="0"/>
        <viewAttribute datatype="DECIMAL" id="BELNR" length="10" scale="0"/>
        <viewAttribute datatype="NVARCHAR" id="CLEARED" length="3"/>
        <viewAttribute datatype="NVARCHAR" id="PARTN" length="55"/>
        <viewAttribute datatype="NVARCHAR" id="CURRENCY" length="5"/>
        <viewAttribute datatype="DECIMAL" id="AMOUNT" length="17" scale="2"/>
      </viewAttributes>
      <calculatedViewAttributes/>
      <definition> 
 /********* Begin Procedure Script ************/ 
BEGIN 
    
    -- Get latest BS
    ranking = SELECT COUNT(t_b.mandt)+1 rank, 
                     t_a.mandt, t_a.kukey, t_a.azdat,
                     t_a.bukrs, t_a.hbkid, t_a.hktid, t_a.waers,
                     t_a.esvoz, t_a.esbtr
                FROM febko t_a LEFT JOIN febko t_b ON (t_a.mandt = t_b.mandt
                                      AND t_a.anwnd = t_b.anwnd
                                      AND t_a.absnd = t_b.absnd
                                      AND t_a.azidt = t_b.azidt
                                      AND t_a.emkey = t_b.emkey
                                      AND t_a.azdat = t_b.azdat
                                      AND t_a.seq_number > t_b.seq_number)
               GROUP BY t_a.mandt, t_a.kukey, t_a.azdat,
                        t_a.bukrs, t_a.hbkid, t_a.hktid, t_a.waers,
                        t_a.esvoz, t_a.esbtr;
    
    ranktop = SELECT *
                FROM :ranking 
               WHERE rank = 1;
               
    -- Get Line Item
    litem   = SELECT t_f.mandt, t_f.kukey, t_r.azdat,
                     t_r.bukrs, t_r.hbkid, t_r.hktid,
                     t_f.gjahr, t_f.belnr, t_f.partn,
                     t_f.epvoz, t_f.kwaer, t_f.kwbtr
                FROM febep t_f JOIN :ranking t_r ON (t_f.mandt = t_r.mandt
                                      AND t_f.kukey = t_r.kukey);
                                      
    var_out = SELECT t_l.mandt, 
                     t_amd.banks, t_amd.bankl, t_amd.acc_id, t_amd.acc_type_id,
                     t_l.azdat trans_date, t_l.bukrs, t_l.gjahr, t_l.belnr,
                     MAP(t_l.belnr, '', 'No', 'Yes') cleared,
                     t_l.partn, t_l.kwaer currency,
                     MAP(t_l.epvoz, 'H', t_l.kwbtr, 0 - t_l.kwbtr) amount
                FROM :litem t_l LEFT JOIN fclm_bam_ac_link t_link ON (t_l.mandt = t_link.mandt
                                      AND t_l.bukrs = t_link.bukrs
                                      AND t_l.hbkid = t_link.hbkid
                                      AND t_l.hktid = t_link.hktid)
                                LEFT JOIN fclm_bam_amd t_amd ON (t_link.mandt = t_amd.mandt
                                      AND t_link.acc_id = t_amd.acc_id);


END /********* End Procedure Script ************/</definition>
    </calculationView>
  </calculationViews>
  <logicalModel id="Script_View">

    <attributes>
      <attribute id="MANDT" order="1">

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<Calculation:scenario xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:Calculation="http://www.sap.com/ndb/BiModelCalculation.ecore" schemaVersion="2.3" id="CV_ITEM" applyPrivilegeType="ANALYTIC_PRIVILEGE" checkAnalyticPrivileges="true" defaultClient="$$client$$" defaultLanguage="$$language$$" hierarchiesSQLEnabled="false" translationRelevant="true" visibility="reportingEnabled" calculationScenarioType="SCRIPT_BASED" dataCategory="CUBE" enforceSqlExecution="true" executionSemantic="UNDEFINED" runWithInvokerPrivileges="true" scriptParametersCaseSensitive="true">
  <origin/>
  <descriptions defaultDescription="Bank In/Out detail"/>
  <metadata changedAt="2015-08-10 16:24:38.304"/>
  <defaultSchema schemaName="SAP_ECC"/>
  <localVariables/>
  <variableMappings/>
  <dataSources/>
  <calculationViews>
    <calculationView xsi:type="Calculation:SqlScriptView" id="Script_View">
      <descriptions/>
      <viewAttributes>
        <viewAttribute datatype="NVARCHAR" id="MANDT" length="3"/>
        <viewAttribute datatype="NVARCHAR" id="BANKS" length="3"/>
        <viewAttribute datatype="NVARCHAR" id="BANKL" length="15"/>
        <viewAttribute datatype="NVARCHAR" id="ACC_ID" length="10"/>
        <viewAttribute datatype="NVARCHAR" id="ACC_TYPE_ID" length="10"/>
        <viewAttribute datatype="NVARCHAR" id="VALUE_DATE" length="8"/>
        <viewAttribute datatype="NVARCHAR" id="BUKRS" length="4"/>
        <viewAttribute datatype="NVARCHAR" id="GJAHR" length="4"/>
        <viewAttribute datatype="NVARCHAR" id="BELNR" length="10"/>
        <viewAttribute datatype="NVARCHAR" id="BUZEI" length="3"/>
        <viewAttribute datatype="NVARCHAR" id="LQPOS" length="16"/>
        <viewAttribute datatype="NVARCHAR" id="CLEARED" length="3"/>
        <viewAttribute datatype="NVARCHAR" id="CURRENCY" length="5"/>
        <viewAttribute datatype="DECIMAL" id="AMOUNT" length="17" scale="2"/>
      </viewAttributes>
      <calculatedViewAttributes/>
      <definition> 
 /********* Begin Procedure Script ************/ 
 BEGIN 
 
 	var_out = SELECT NULL mandt, NULL banks, NULL bankl,
                       NULL acc_id, NULL acc_type_id, NULL value_date, 
                       NULL bukrs,NULL gjahr, NULL belnr, NULL buzei, 
                       NULL lqpos,                       
                       NULL cleared,                       
                       NULL currency, 
                       NULL amount
                FROM dummy;
 
 /*
      var_out = SELECT tmp_pymt.mandt, t012.banks, t012.bankl,
                       t_link.acc_id, t_amd.acc_type_id, tmp_pymt.fi_value_date value_date, 
                       bkpf.bukrs, bkpf.gjahr, bkpf.belnr, bseg.buzei, 
                       tmp_pymt.liquidity_item lqpos,                       
                       (CASE WHEN tmp_pymt.flow_level = '90' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END) cleared,                       
                       bkpf.waers currency, 
                       (CASE WHEN SHKZG = 'S' THEN bseg.wrbtr ELSE 0 - bseg.wrbtr END) amount
                  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT a.mandt, a.company_code, a.fi_fiscal_year, a.fi_document_number, 
                               a.fi_document_line_item, a.fi_value_date, a.house_bank, a.house_bank_account, 
                               a.liquidity_item, c.flow_level
                          FROM fqm_flow a JOIN fqmc_flow_type b ON (a.mandt = b.mandt 
                                                                AND a.lp_flow_type = b.flow_type )
                               JOIN fqmi_flow_cat c ON (b.flow_category = c.flow_category)
                               JOIN fclm_lqf_ind_asg i ON (c.flow_level = i.flow_level)
                         WHERE i.doc_indicator = 'A' 
                           AND a.flg_actual = 'X'
                           AND a.deleted = ''
                           AND a.house_bank <> ''
                           AND a.house_bank_account <> '') tmp_pymt
                       JOIN bseg ON (tmp_pymt.mandt = bseg.mandt
                                AND tmp_pymt.company_code = bseg.bukrs
                                AND tmp_pymt.fi_fiscal_year = bseg.gjahr
                                AND tmp_pymt.fi_document_number = bseg.belnr
                                AND tmp_pymt.fi_document_line_item = bseg.buzei)
                       JOIN bkpf ON (bseg.mandt = bkpf.mandt
                                AND bseg.bukrs = bkpf.bukrs
                                AND bseg.gjahr = bkpf.gjahr
                                AND bseg.belnr = bkpf.belnr)
                       LEFT JOIN t012 ON (tmp_pymt.mandt = t012.mandt
                                AND tmp_pymt.company_code = t012.bukrs
                                AND tmp_pymt.house_bank = t012.hbkid)
                       LEFT JOIN fclm_bam_ac_link t_link ON (tmp_pymt.mandt = t_link.mandt
                                AND tmp_pymt.company_code = t_link.bukrs
                                AND tmp_pymt.house_bank = t_link.hbkid
                                AND tmp_pymt.house_bank_account = t_link.hktid)
                       LEFT JOIN fclm_bam_amd t_amd ON (t_link.mandt = t_amd.mandt
                                                    AND t_link.acc_id = t_amd.acc_id);
*/
END /********* End Procedure Script ************/</definition>
    </calculationView>
  </calculationViews>
  <logicalModel id="Script_View">

      <definition> 
 /********* Begin Procedure Script ************/ 
 BEGIN
